title: Director at Accounting Firm Expects Docusign Growth to Be Led by CLM and Intelligent Agreement Management
expert: Director at a top-20 national CPA firm's software advisory, resale and implementation practice; Docusign 25%–30% of agreement-platform opportunities
verdict: The expert's Docusign-related business grew 7%–12% in Aug–Oct 2026, with CLM/IAM expansions lifting contract value 8%–15%, but only 20%–30% of IAM pilots converted to paid in the first cycle.

Back to double-digit growth: 🟢 **Business up 7%–12%** in Aug–Oct 2026, vs +~5% and +~20% from the 2026-11-05 calls: in between.
🟢 **9%–14% next quarter** (estimate), with qualified pipeline at 108%–115% of target.
DBNR / renewal expansion: 🟢 **NRR 106%–112%, GRR 93%–96%** (practice) vs the page's DBNR of 101%: higher.
🟢 **CLM/IAM expansions lift ACV 8%–15%** vs Cleveland's high end of ~5-10% (SB #63574): higher.
IAM adoption: 🔴 **Only 20%–30% of IAM/AI pilots convert to paid** in the first cycle; 15%–20% of larger CLM/IAM deals slipping.

changes: CLM/IAM expansion ACV uplift 8%–15% vs Cleveland high end of ~5-10% (SB #63574): higher.
NRR 106%–112% at the expert's practice vs DBNR 101% (thesis page, FY25 disclosure): higher.
Business +7%–12% vs +~5% (2026-11-05, AI-co exec) and +~20% (2026-11-05, consulting PMO): in between.
Core e-signature demand +2%–5% vs envelopes and seats roughly flat (2026-11-05, consulting PMO): consistent.
thesis_impact: Stance (neutral; DD growth): ↑ — 7%–12% now, 9%–14% next quarter (estimate), pipeline 108%–115% of target.
Stance (IAM bet): → — IAM interest +25%–40% and ACV uplift 8%–15%, offset by 20%–30% pilot conversion and slipping deals.
